judgment.rationale: The report gives a concrete restore boundary and the earlier diagnostic summary found malformed JSON errors across multiple modules during restoration. Local restore code writes merged settings and then restarts the app without validating each module result.

RestoreSettings writes merged or overwritten settings files and then restarts Settings after any successful update set.

issue_context.summary: Restoring settings from backup can crash the Settings experience when the current configuration differs from the newest backup, and the diagnostic trail points to malformed module JSON during restoration.

actions.label: Reproduce backup restore with divergent settings

reproduce.title: Verify restore behavior when backup and current settings diverge
reproduce.version_requirement: PowerToys 0.101.2453 or equivalent current main build
setup: Change one or more module settings so the current state differs from the newest backup.
steps: Open Settings > General > Back up and restore.
Click Restore while the latest backup differs from the current settings.
Watch the UI transition and the affected settings files on disk.
reproduce.expected_result: Restore should either succeed cleanly or surface a precise file-level validation error; it should not crash back to the home screen or leave the window in a broken drag state.

proposed_fixes.title: Validate restore payloads before restarting Settings
proposed_fixes.root_cause: RestoreSettings can leave malformed or incompatible module JSON on disk after merge/overwrite, then restarts into partially restored state instead of surfacing a per-file restore failure.
plan: Validate each restored file after merge/overwrite and stop before restart if any file is malformed or schema-incompatible.
Report the exact failing file instead of treating the whole restore as successful.
Prefer explicit overwrite paths for modules already known not to merge cleanly and add regression cases using divergent current/backup settings.
verification: Create a backup, diverge current settings, click Restore, and confirm the flow either completes cleanly or reports the exact file-level failure without crashing the Settings window.

confidence.rationale: The restore path and malformed-JSON evidence are strong, but a maintainer-side repro is still needed to pin the exact file patterns.
